body.purpose: Aggregate supply volume for one known vendor over a common receipt window.
when_to_use: Aggregate supply volume for one known vendor over a common receipt window.
when_not_to_use: Use compare_vendors for two or more vendors; this does not measure vendor quality.
preconditions: Read bookstore://reference for vendor IDs and fixed clock.
Use ISO paired dates, known IDs, and no unsupported parameters.
